rachel: Payments flagged a sudden spike of CHARGEBACKS for merchant acct `acct_Fn7` — ~14 disputes in 90 minutes. Can someone triage?

payments-bot: Alert: 14 CHARGEBACKS (CB04/CB30), potential card-testing pattern, repeated BINs and tiny-amount tests.

fraud-bot: Rule hits: CARD_TESTING_DETECT, IP_RATE_LIMIT. 10 unique cards, 6 had failed AVS. Geo: high volume from BR/PH.

ops-oncall: recommend soft block on new checkouts for acct_Fn7 and hold settlements until we review. I can apply a block now.

sam: please block. also capture auth logs, IPs, user agents and any webhook callbacks. we'll need evidence for PSP and possibly to refund affected customers.

rachel: ops, can you export last 30 days of transactions and refunds for that acct and drop to S3?

ops-oncall: export started; s3://redwood-ops-exports/1833002468-acct_Fn7-tx.csv when ready.

fraud-bot: note: 3DS present on only 4 of the flagged txs. Recommend enforcing 3DS for new card adds and throttling small-value auths.

sam: agreed. product to enforce 3DS and rate-limit tokenization. I'll assemble dispute packet and contact PSP rep to request extended evidence window.

rachel: checklist: [x] soft block, [x] export started, [ ] evidence packet, [ ] PSP contact, [ ] sales/merchant notif. Keeping thread open until cleared.
